ctgov.note: No P1/P2/P3 sponsored trials returned for AVITA Medical. Company conducts post-market clinical studies for already-approved devices.

marketed_devices.name: RECELL (RECELL 1920, RECELL EOU, RECELL GO, RECELL GO mini)
marketed_devices.modality: Autologous cell harvesting device (Spray-On Skin Cells)
indications: Acute thermal burns (PMA Sep 2018; pediatric expansion Jun 2021)
Repigmentation of stable depigmented vitiligo (PMA Jun 2023; commercial investment paused)
marketed_devices.regulatory: FDA PMA approved; CE Mark for RECELL GO Sep 2025; PMDA Japan (burns); TGA Australia

marketed_devices.name: Cohealyx
marketed_devices.modality: Bovine collagen-based dermal matrix (distributed under Regenity agreement)
indications: Wound bed preparation for full-thickness wounds
marketed_devices.regulatory: FDA 510(k) cleared Dec 19, 2024; US launch Apr 1, 2025

marketed_devices.name: PermeaDerm
marketed_devices.modality: Biosynthetic wound matrix (manufactured and distributed under Stedical agreement)
indications: Treatment of various wound types until healing

ongoing_post_market_studies: Cohealyx 40-patient post-market study (time-to-graft reduction in full-thickness wounds and burns)
PermeaDerm post-market study, ~40 patients, health economic comparison vs human cadaveric allograft

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical device (medtech) company. All proprietary products (RECELL platform, Cohealyx, PermeaDerm) are FDA-approved or 510(k)-cleared and commercially marketed. Ongoing clinical activity is limited to post-market evidence-generation studies for already-approved devices, which are not pre-approval P1/P2/P3 drug trials.
